title: Payouts
subtitle: The Mercado Pago account where you receive the money from your sales on EKORU.
finishing: Finishing the connection with Mercado Pago…
readOnly: Only the business owner, or whoever manages its profile, can change the payout account.

explain.connected: Buyers can now pay for your products and services. The money goes straight to this account.
explain.reconnect: The Mercado Pago authorization expired or was revoked. Until you renew it, nobody can pay you on EKORU.
explain.disconnected: Connect your Mercado Pago account to start selling. Until you do, your products and services cannot be paid for on EKORU.

disconnect.confirm: Disconnect this account? Buyers won't be able to pay you until you connect one again. Refunds of past sales keep working.

how.title: How it works
how.direct: Buyers pay straight into your Mercado Pago account. EKORU never receives or holds the money from your sales.
how.commission: EKORU's commission ({{percent}} of each sale) is deducted automatically by Mercado Pago when the buyer pays.
how.providerFee: Mercado Pago also deducts its own fee, according to your account's terms.
how.refunds: If a sale is refunded, Mercado Pago returns the buyer's money and EKORU's commission is returned in the same proportion.

feedback.declined: The Mercado Pago authorization was not completed
feedback.error: The action could not be completed
